artworks.label: Cherry ballet slippers
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original square 1024x1024 standalone Glaze small-widget illustration for cherry-ribbon. One exquisite pair of miniature ivory linen ballet slippers gently overlapping, lustrous dusty-rose satin ribbons forming two soft loops, delicate cherry-red satin-stitch cherries with olive-green stitched leaves embroidered on the toes, fine scalloped cream seams. Refined tactile textile still-life photography, visible linen weave and subtle silk sheen, soft natural light; sophisticated cream/rose/cherry palette. No brooch, locket, butterfly or needlebook. Full subject centered with ample18percent transparent margins, clear shape at tiny size. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no floor, opaque square, framing or collage. Pure illustration only: no text, numbers, lettering, dates, clocks, dials, hands, calendars, UI, brand or watermark. Entirely new artwork, no copy/crop/recolour.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
